purpose: Teach: 感傷/従順/習性/一服/四角い/極まりない/輝か/育む

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが古い写真を見て感傷に浸ってらしたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father got a bit lost in an old photo earlier.
lines.style: Warm, observant tone. Gentle amusement at the domestic moment. Soft opening on the name. Not mocking—noticing something tender and wanting to share it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんに従順な子になりたいよ
lines.en: Mom, I want to be the kind of kid Dad is proud of.
lines.style: Quiet, earnest intensity. No hesitation—this matters to him. Small voice but steady. The vowel at the end of 'proud' holds just a moment longer, like he's imagining it.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんは夜更かしする習性がおありね
lines.en: Sho, your father does have a habit of staying up late, doesn't he.
lines.style: Knowing, gentle wryness. Not criticizing—observing the pattern with the affection of someone who knows him well. Slight arch on 'habit.' The period lands soft, inviting agreement rather than judgment.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんが煙草を一服されてたよ
lines.en: Mom, I saw Dad outside having a cigarette just now.
lines.style: Quiet, factual report, but noticing—the way he says it carries the weight of him watching his father. Not alarmed. Just... present. A small pause before he says it, like he's deciding whether it matters.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが四角い顔の人形を作って下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your father made a little doll with a square face for you.
lines.style: Warm delight underneath. She's pleased at the gesture, amused by the oddity of it. Opens bright on 'Sho.' Lets the image settle—square face, handmade, from Dad. Genuine pleasure.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、極まりない感謝をお父さんに伝えたよ
lines.en: Mom, I told Dad how grateful I am. Really grateful.
lines.style: Soft intensity. Not performative—genuine and slightly shy about expressing it. Repeats 'grateful' not because he's stammering but because the first word didn't quite catch everything he feels. Small but full.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんの瞳が輝かれてるのを見ると嬉しいわね
lines.en: Sho, it makes me happy to see your father's eyes light up like that.
lines.style: Tender, almost to herself but shared with him. A moment of noticing something quietly profound—the small joy of watching love work. Very soft opening. Lets the image breathe. Trails off into affection.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんが家族の絆を育む方なのよね
lines.en: Mom, Dad really does know how to build something that holds us together.
lines.style: Small, wise voice. Not just talking about the doll—understanding something larger and saying it simply. Slow, deliberate. The kind of thing a six-year-old perceives without being taught. Warm and still.
